verification.note: migrated from data/antibiogram-raw.json: extracted from the source PDF, then re-verified cell by cell by a second reader (2026). Method: Figures come from Table 2 (page 3), printed as n (%) sensitive, and were checked against the page 4 text. The 2018 ceftriaxone entry is printed as '4 (7.5%)', which does not match 40 isolates; the printed 7.5% is used. MDR and XDR counts in Table 3 are not per drug.

notes: Sharma et al. (Cureus 2023) studied Klebsiella pneumoniae from endotracheal aspirates of mechanically ventilated ICU patients with ventilator-associated pneumonia at Sri Guru Ram Das Institute of Medical Sciences and Research, Amritsar. This entry is the January to June 2018 cohort (40 isolates); a separate entry holds January to June 2022 (42). Figures are % susceptible as printed. The paper's headline finding is the fall in colistin susceptibility from 92% in 2018 to 28% in 2022; meropenem fell from 15% to 2.5%, minocycline rose from 67% to 100% and XDR strains rose from 62.5% to 71%. Ampicillin, 100% resistant in both periods by the text, is not in the table and is not shown. No ESBL rate is reported. The 2018 minocycline count is printed oddly (26.8), so the printed 67% is used.
